entry.label: Prigogine: order under non-equilibrium conditions (Challoner, 2026)
entry.description: Challoner separates equilibrium, stationary states, and far-from-equilibrium behaviour. Sustained exchange, instability, and fluctuations help explain dissipative structures in specified physical systems. These propositions require separate argument and evidence before application to organisations.
